adds.rationale: Rocket Lab's Q1 2022 print shows genuine buildup-phase commercial traction in the user's top-priority next wave, freeing capacity by trimming the weakest of four AI-bucket mega-caps.

news_evidence.summary: Rocket Lab reports Q1 2022 revenue of $40.7M, up 124% YoY, with Space Systems segment revenue up 1,873% YoY; guides Q2 2022 revenue of $51-54M

removes.rationale: Weakest of the four AI-bucket mega-caps this quarter: Q1 2022 print showed YouTube ad revenue decelerating sharply to 14% YoY (from 49% a year earlier), missing estimates by over $600M, partly on European advertiser pullback tied to the Ukraine war, making it the marginal holding to trim to fund next-wave entry.

news_evidence.summary: Alphabet Q1 2022: YouTube ad revenue growth decelerates to 14% YoY ($6.9B), missing Wall Street estimates by over $600M; slowdown partly attributed to European brand-advertiser pullback tied to Russia's war on Ukraine
Alphabet Q1 2022 8-K: total revenue $68.01B (+23% YoY) but net income down 8% YoY, missing on both top and bottom line

rationale_overall: Kept AAPL, MSFT, NVDA and LMT: MSFT's Azure grew 46% YoY and NVDA posted record Data Center and Gaming revenue in their most recent prints (both filed before this quarter's cutoff), and LMT's Ukraine-driven Javelin replenishment contracts (May-June 2022) strongly reconfirm the defense/rearmament thesis. Trimmed GOOGL, whose Q1 2022 print showed the softest signal of the four AI names (YouTube ad deceleration, war-linked European ad pullback), to fund an entry into RKLB on the strength of a genuine, dated Q1 2022 commercial buildup (124% revenue growth) in the user's #1-ranked next wave, rockets & spacecraft. Considered but did not add tanker names (FRO/STNG, benefiting from 2022 war-driven freight-rate spikes) and uranium/nuclear names (CCJ, benefiting from Russia-uranium-supply concerns) given no free slot remained after this single swap; these remain candidates for a future rebalance. Net effect: watchlist shape shifts from 4-AI/1-defense to 3-AI/1-defense/1-rockets, adding the first foothold in a named next wave without breaching the 4-per-bucket diversity cap or the 5-ticker size cap.
